This plot is only a quarter hectare and it is rented, so I cannot spend too much on it — whatever I put in, half the benefit goes to the landlord in my mind. I will buy a small bag of DAP and urea from the cooperative because without fertilizer the soil here in Oromia gives almost nothing, but I will use less than on my own land. I keep a few cattle so I will carry manure from the kraal before planting. I cannot afford to irrigate or hire much labor, so my husband and I will do most of the weeding ourselves, and I will only call in a few neighbors for harvest.
